label: Common
about: What anyone may own and what lies about on safe ground. Vanilla hands these out from level 1 (measured gates: iron, steel weapons, hide, iron, studded armour at 1; leather at 6, taken here because it is the marsh's own make).

label: Sound
about: Good working gear: the D2 ground's band (foes at level 10). Vanilla gates: imperial at 4, steel armour, leather and orcish weapons at 6, imperial armour at 7 to 8; enchantment grade 2 at 4 and 3 at 9.

label: Fine
about: Fine, foreign or old-made gear: the D3 ground's band (foes at level 20). Vanilla gates: dwarven and elven armour at 12, steel plate and elven weapons at 18 to 19, scaled at 19; enchantment grade 4 at 17. Chitin and bonemold are Morrowind's make, carried over the border (provenance).

label: Rare
about: What a capital's treasury or a deep ruin holds: the D4 ground's band (foes at level 35). Vanilla gates: orcish armour 25, elven gilded and glass weapons 27, ebony armour 32; enchantment grade 5 at 30.

label: Precious
about: The best a place can hold without a story: the D5 ground's band (foes at level 50) and the richest cities' vaults. Vanilla gates: glass armour and ebony weapons at 36.

label: Exceptional
about: Uniques and the best gear: authored by story only and counted in the world ledger (newworld/places/exceptional.jsonl); never derived. Vanilla gates: dragonplate 40, daedric and dragonscale 46 to 48; enchantment grade 6 at 43.
